verdict.rationale: decK enables declarative config sync/orchestration across an entire Kong Gateway state (many services, routes, plugins) in one operation, and Insomnia's CLI/test tooling supports executing unlimited test runs simultaneously and automating bulk test execution via Inso CLI — both point toward bulk operations across many items. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'bulk operations' API/endpoint or batch-processing semantics, and no independent evidence validating bulk behavior at scale. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API documentation, hands-on evidence of large-scale bulk operations, and confirmation this works reliably (e.g., no batch-related failure reports).
